alert_news.title: India’s First Indigenous HPV Vaccine Receives WHO Pre‑qualification
bullets: Cervavac, India’s first indigenously developed HPV vaccine, pre‑qualified by WHO, developed by Serum Institute of India (SII) with the Department of Biotechnology, BIRAC, WHO IARC and Gates Foundation.
Quadrivalent, gender‑neutral vaccine protects against HPV strains 6, 11, 16 and 18 for ages 9‑26, enabling global procurement by UN agencies.

alert_news.title: Airtel Business launches India's first telco-grade network - Bisinfotech
bullets: India’s first telco‑grade network intelligence platform, Airtel IQ Gateway, launched nationwide by Airtel Business.
DPDP‑compliant platform integrating SMS, WhatsApp, RCS, voice and number verification into a single control plane.

alert_news.title: Airtel Business Unveils IQ Gateway: India's First Telco-Grade Enterprise Messaging Platform
bullets: First telco‑grade network intelligence platform in India, launched by Airtel Business, integrating SMS, WhatsApp, RCS, voice and number verification into a single DPDP‑compliant control plane
Provides fraud protection, DLT template management, automatic routing and silent authentication for enterprise communications

alert_news.title: India's First Indigenous Fleet Support Ship ‘Surya’ Launched at Hindustan Shipyard, Vizag
bullets: First indigenous Fleet Support Ship (FSS‑1 ‘Surya’) built by Hindustan Shipyard Limited, Visakhapatnam for the Indian Navy
Displacement 43,500 tonnes; capable of replenishing warships at sea; constructed under Make‑in‑India with slipway capacity up to 45,000 DWT

alert_news.title: India’s First Advanced Ergonomics & Human Factors Research Centre Set Up in Pune
bullets: First Advanced Ergonomics and Human Factors Research Centre (AEHFRC) in India, jointly established by ARAI and COEP Technological University in Pune
38,000 sq ft facility with Rs 105 crore investment; will serve automotive, defence, aerospace, rail, agriculture and other sectors, evolving into a national centre of excellence

alert_news.title: NYAI AI Studio Unifies AI Agents, Data and Legal Workflows
bullets: India’s first agentic AI infrastructure platform for law firms and enterprise legal/compliance functions, launched by NYAI.
NYAI AI Studio integrates AI agents, data, workflows, and governance in a single environment, enabling end‑to‑end legal work on proprietary data.

alert_news.title: India's first 5.56‑km free‑space QKD link between BISAG‑N and IIT Gandhinagar
bullets: First free‑space quantum key distribution (QKD) link in India covering 5.56 km, established by QNu Labs, BISAG‑N and IIT Gandhinagar
Achieved stable quantum bit error rate (QBER) below 5% and secure key rate of 230–260 bps using DPS‑Decoy protocol over 1550 nm channel

alert_news.title: India’s First AI Data Centre Park in Chhattisgarh
bullets: India’s first AI Data Centre Park located in Chhattisgarh, established by the state government.
Planned 100‑MW AI‑ready data centre campus to be built by Singapore‑headquartered Energy Capital Global with an FDI commitment of ₹41,750 crore.

alert_news.title: India’s First Agentic AI Infrastructure Platform for Law Firms
bullets: NYAI AI Studio, launched in 2026, is India’s first agentic AI infrastructure platform designed for law firms and enterprise legal/compliance functions.
The platform integrates AI agents, data, workflows, and governance to deliver end‑to‑end legal work, supporting model‑agnostic deployment with Claude, GPT, Microsoft Copilot, and Gemini.

alert_news.title: Andhra Pradesh to Pilot India's First 3D-Printed Rural Houses under PMAY‑G
bullets: AP launches India’s first national‑level pilot of 3D concrete‑printing houses under PMAY‑G, reducing construction time to days.
Project uses robotic gantry to deposit high‑performance cementitious mix, eliminating formwork and cutting material waste by up to 60%.

alert_news.title: VOC Port in Thoothukudi to set up India's first offshore wind turbine
bullets: VO Chidambaranar Port Authority installs India’s first offshore wind turbine (6.25 MW) at Thoothukudi, a prototype offshore wind farm.
Turbine positioned 1.65 km from breakwater in 9.7 m depth, Rs 77.41 crore project, transmitting power to state grid via submarine cable.

alert_news.title: Assam to Get India's First Underwater Road-cum-Rail Tunnel
bullets: India’s first underwater road‑cum‑rail tunnel: a 15.79‑km twin‑tube tunnel beneath the Brahmaputra River linking Gohpur (NH‑15) to Numaligarh (NH‑715) in Assam, built under the Ministry of Road Transport and Highways.
Project cost Rs 220 billion, part of a 33.7‑km four‑lane corridor; expected to cut travel time from 6 hours to ~20 minutes and connect two airports, four railway stations, and two inland waterways.

alert_news.title: India's First Agentic AI Campus Takes Shape at KLH Hyderabad
bullets: India’s first Agentic AI Campus inaugurated at KLH Hyderabad (Bachupally), a collaboration between KLH Hyderabad and HCL Group AI Labs, integrating AI‑powered learning into the curriculum.
The campus aims to develop AI‑driven project‑based learning across disciplines, making it the first Indian institution to embed agentic AI in its academic framework.

alert_news.title: QNu Labs completes India's first 5-km free-space QKD
bullets: India’s first free‑space quantum key distribution (QKD) link of 5.56 km between BISAG‑N and IIT Gandhinagar, demonstrated by QNu Labs, BISAG‑N and IIT Gandhinagar on 27–28 Sep 2026.
Link operated at 1550 nm with DPS‑Decoy protocol, achieving QBER <5 % and a secure key rate of 230–260 bps, integrated with post‑quantum cryptography (PQC) via Vedic Kavach.

alert_news.title: India’s First Free‑Space Quantum Key Distribution Demonstration
bullets: India’s first free‑space QKD trial over 5.56 km between BISAG‑N and IIT Gandhinagar
Achieved quantum bit error rate <5% and key generation rate 230–260 bits per second

alert_news.title: India Demonstrates First Free‑Space Quantum Link
bullets: India’s first free‑space QKD link over 5.56 km between BISAG‑N and IIT Gandhinagar
Stable QBER <5% and key rate 230–260 bps, integrated with Vedic Kavach post‑quantum platform
